title: Beroepstelling 1899
publisher: Statistics Netherlands (CBS) and Netherlands Institute for Scientific Information Services (NIWI)
scope: National and provincial 1899 census tabulations. Provincial totals cover all municipalities, including those with 5,000 or fewer inhabitants represented only by a provincial aggregate. Each observation is the sex-specific or combined all-age count.

extraction.filter: Gebieden NL1000 and the 11 PVxx00 province totals. Beroepen 49990000S, 50980000S, 39980000S, 40980000S, 41980000S, 42980000S, 43980000S, 44980000S, 46980000S, 47980000S and 48980000S. All three Geslacht keys.
extraction.method: Export the 396 filtered rows in source order as UTF-8 CSV. Ongehuwd_1 and Gehuwd_2 are the two all-age cells used for a count. OnbekendeBurgerlijkeStaat_3 is a footnote subset already included in Ongehuwd_1. Pagina_33 records the original volume and page. Retain population and principal occupation controls, pensioners, unknown occupation and without-occupation rows as observation context. Groningen and North Holland have inconsistent printed combined population controls. The runtime uses the independent matched general-census population and the six occupational group counts reproduced by the separate-sex series. Use the separate-sex sum for South Holland trade and transport, where the published combined count is one higher. The inconsistent national-minus-province remainder is unassigned.
